newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo's RTB Bor signs $3.2 mln credit deal - Politika.
newsitem.headline: Yugo's RTB Bor signs $3.2 mln credit deal - Politika.

text.p: Yugoslav copper mining and smelting complex RTB Bor has signed a $3.24 million credit deal with Volvo Euclid of the United States for the purchase of equipment, Belgrade newspaper Politika reported on Wednesday.
The credit deal, guaranteed by Belgrade-based Kapital banka, will cover the purchase of two 170-190 tonne trucks for work on surface mines, spare parts and additional equipment.

"The funds for the purchase of the trucks have been secured by the producer, the U.S. firm Volvo Euclid, with guarantees from Belgrade's Kapital banka," RTB Bor copper and non-metals mines director Blagoje Spaskovski is quoted as saying.
The deal was signed on Tuesday by Spaskovski and Volvo Euclid sales manager Dan Wilson in the presence of Kapital Banka director Djordje Nicovic.

According to the report, RTB Bor plans to purchase two more trucks of the same type and under the same conditions later on. No other details were available. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom + 381 11 222 4305
